hints: Find the amplitude $p$ by calculating $\frac{\text{max} - \text{min}}{2}$ from the graph.
walkthrough:
Calculate the amplitude $p$ from the peak and trough of the graph (maximum $1$, minimum $-5$):
$$p = \frac{1 - (-5)}{2} = \frac{6}{2} = 3$$

hints: Determine the period $T$ from the graph and use $T = \frac{2\pi}{q}$ to solve for $q$.
walkthrough:
Determine the period $T$ of one complete cycle from the graph ($T = 4\pi$):
$$\text{Period} = \frac{2\pi}{q} = 4\pi \implies q = \frac{2\pi}{4\pi} = \frac{1}{2}$$

hints: Find the midline value $r$ by calculating $\frac{\text{max} + \text{min}}{2}$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the vertical shift $r$ (midline of the wave) using the maximum and minimum values:
$$r = \frac{1 + (-5)}{2} = \frac{-4}{2} = -2$$
